excerpt.en: A commercial dairy needed to move beyond row-level spraying. We engineered a stall-level control system that detects cow presence and activates only the corresponding spray position.
excerpt.zh: 牧场需要摆脱整排喷淋的粗放方式。我们设计了牛位级控制系统：检测牛只是否在位，只启动对应位置的喷头。

coverAlt.en: Sensor-activated spray-cooling retrofit in a commercial dairy barn
coverAlt.zh: 商业牧场牛舍内的传感器触发式喷淋降温改造

heading.en: The system could deliver water—but not according to actual cow occupancy.
heading.zh: 原系统能把水送出去，却送不到真正需要的位置。

quote.en: Detect whether a cow is present at each position, and activate only the nozzle serving that occupied position.
quote.zh: 检测每个位置上是否有牛，只启动该位置对应的喷头。

text.en: Every nozzle on the line operated, even when positions were unoccupied.
text.zh: 管线上的所有喷头一起动作，位置上没有牛也照喷。

text.en: A single valve controlled an entire row—or, in some areas, a complete barn line.
text.zh: 一个阀控制一整排——部分区域甚至是一整条牛舍管线。

text.en: Long cable runs and secondary field wiring slowed installation and troubleshooting.
text.zh: 线路长、现场二次接线多，安装和排查都被拖慢。

heading.en: From pipe-level operation to cow-position-level control.
heading.zh: 从管路级运行，下沉到牛位级控制。

imageAlt.en: Engineering comparison of row-level spraying and position-level precision control
imageAlt.zh: 整排喷淋与单位置精准控制的工程对比

heading.en: One coordinated architecture—from presence detection to remote operations.
heading.zh: 一套协同的架构——从在位检测一直到远程运维。

intro.en: The requirement could not be solved by adding a sensor alone. Sensing, field connectivity, PLC decision logic, individual valve actuation and operator visibility had to operate as one control loop.
intro.zh: 这个需求不是加个传感器就能解决的。感应、现场连接、PLC 判断逻辑、单阀执行与运行可见性，必须作为一个控制闭环协同工作。

imageAlt.en: Layered architecture of the sensor-activated precision spray-cooling system
imageAlt.zh: 传感器触发式精准喷淋降温系统的分层架构

banner.en: Presence Detection → Field Signal → PLC Decision → Individual Valve Actuation → Operational Feedback
banner.zh: 在位检测 → 现场信号 → PLC 判断 → 单阀执行 → 运行反馈

heading.en: Four custom elements designed around the barn—not adapted from a generic control package.
heading.zh: 四个围绕牛舍现场定制的部件——不是通用控制方案改一改。

text.en: Evaluates cow presence at the corresponding spray position and sends the field signal to the control system.
text.zh: 判断对应喷淋位置上是否有牛，并把现场信号送给控制系统。

imageAlt.zh: 即插即用 T 型线束

title.zh: 即插即用 T 型线束

text.en: Standardized connections eliminate unnecessary secondary wiring and simplify installation, replacement and expansion.
text.zh: 标准化连接取消了不必要的二次接线，安装、更换与扩展都更简单。

text.en: Applies presence, temperature, timing and zoning logic before commanding the corresponding solenoid valve.
text.zh: 综合在位、温度、时序与分区逻辑判断后，再驱动对应的电磁阀。

text.en: Provides equipment status, operating visibility, parameter review and faster localization of abnormal device states.
text.zh: 提供设备状态、运行可见性与参数查看，设备异常也能更快定位。

heading.en: Survey first. Configure for the actual barn. Retrofit by zone.
heading.zh: 先勘查，按实际牛舍配置，分区改造。

text.en: Map water, power, cable routes and existing controls.
text.zh: 梳理水路、电源、线缆走向与现有控制。

text.en: Define positions, sensors, valves and spray points.
text.zh: 确定牛位、传感器、阀门与喷淋点的对应关系。

text.en: Prepare enclosures, harnesses and panels for the barn.
text.zh: 按牛舍实际情况准备感应盒、线束与控制柜。

text.en: Retrofit by zone to reduce operational disruption.
text.zh: 按区改造，尽量不影响日常生产。

text.en: Verify detection, control logic, valve response and timing.
text.zh: 验证检测、控制逻辑、阀门响应与时序。

text.en: Configure mobile operations and train the dairy team.
text.zh: 配置移动端运维并培训牧场团队。

heading.en: A measurable change in how the system is controlled and maintained.
heading.zh: 控制方式与维护方式都发生了实实在在的变化。

after.en: Presence evaluated at each spray position
after.zh: 逐个喷淋位置判断在位
即插即用 T 型线束

after.en: PLC-based temperature, timing and zoning logic
after.zh: PLC 的温度、时序与分区逻辑

after.en: Faster localization by zone and device
after.zh: 按分区与设备快速定位

heading.en: Precision at the spray position. Simplicity in the field. Visibility for operations.
heading.zh: 喷淋位置更精准，现场更简洁，运行更透明。

text.en: Spray activation follows actual occupancy instead of opening every nozzle on the line.
text.zh: 按牛只实际在位启动喷淋，不再一开就是整条管线的喷头。

text.en: Purpose-built, plug-and-play connections reduce field wiring and make replacement easier.
text.zh: 专门设计的即插即用连接减少了现场接线，更换也更方便。

text.en: PLC control and the mobile interface make status, parameters and abnormal conditions easier to manage.
text.zh: PLC 控制与移动端界面让状态、参数与异常都更容易管理。

heading.en: The retrofit redefined the smallest controllable unit of the cooling system.
heading.zh: 这次改造重新定义了降温系统的最小可控单元。

body.en: Control moved from the pipe level to the cow-position level—supported by purpose-built sensing, connectivity, automation and mobile operations.
body.zh: 控制粒度从管路级下沉到牛位级——由专用感应、现场连接、自动化控制与移动运维共同支撑。

statement.en: The goal is not to make every nozzle operate. It is to make the right nozzle operate at the right position.
statement.zh: 目标不是让每个喷头都动，而是让对的喷头在对的位置动。
